en: A colorized vintage view of a stone multi‑arched bridge crossing a river with reflections in the water. On the left is a large building with a tall minaret, suggesting a mosque, and beyond the bridge lies a low town spread across a plain with hills in the distance. Greek text at the top left and English text at the top right identify the location as Larissa in Thessaly. The domain 'www.elia.org.gr' is printed across the lower part of the image.
